FOREWORD 

This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the 
Transport Tractors and Trailers Sectional Committee had been approved by the Transport Engineering 
Division Council. 

In reporting the result of a test or analysis made in accordance with this standard, if the final value, 
observed or calculated, is to be rounded off, it shall be done in accordance with IS 2 : 1960 *Rules for 
rounding off numerical values { revised )'. 



IS 13544 : 1992 



Indian Standard 



TRAILERS — MOUNTING OF BALL BEARING 
TURN TABLE — DIMENSIONS 



1 SCOPE 

This Standard specifies the mounting dimensions 
and sizes of fastener for mounting of ball bearing 
turn table in between the dolly and chassis of full 
trailer ( see Fig. 1 ). 

2 REFERENCES 

The following Indian Standards are necessary 
adjunct to this standard. 



IS No. 



1364 



Title 

Hexagon head bolts, screws 
and nuts of product grades A 
andB : 



( Part 1 ) : 1983 Part 1 Hexagon head bolts 
( size range M3 to M36 ) 
( second revision ) 

( Part 2 ) : 1983 Part 2 Hexagon screws ( size 
range M3 to M36 ) ( second 
revision ) 

( Part 3 ) : 1983 Part 3 Hexagon nuts ( size 
range Ml -6 to M36 ) {second 
revision ) 

2016 : 1967 Plain washers {first revision ) 

5372 : 1975 Taper washers for channels 

( ISMG ) {first revision) 

5373 : 1969 Square washers for wood 

fastenings 



3 RE(iUiREMENTS 

3.1 Ball Bearing Turn Table 

The top and bottom flanges of the ball bearing 
turn table shall be drilled with 17 mm diameter, 
eight holes each as shown in Fig. 2. 

3.2 Mounting 

3.2.1 The ball bearing turn table shall be mount- 
ed on dolly by means of eight hex head bolts/ 
screw/nut M16 x 2 conforming to IS 1364 
( Parts 1 to 3 ) : 1983 with lock nut or nylon nut 
only. 

3*2.2 The ball bearing turn table shall be mount- 
ed below chassis by means of eight hex and bolts/ 
screw/nut M16 x 2 conforming to IS 1364 
( Parts 1 to 3 ) : 1983 with lock nut or nylon nut 
only. 

3.2.3 Machined washer, 17, conforming to 
IS 2016 : 1967 may be used alongwith taper/ 
square washer conforming to IS 5372 : 1975 or 
IS 5373 : 1969, if required. 

3.3 PJates/flanges/webs to which the flanges of 
ball bearing turn table are to be bolted, should 
not be thinner than the flange thickness of ball 
bearing turn table. 

3.4 The longitudinal cross members and the 
struts of trailer chassis as well as dolly should be 
so located that there is a clear access to the hard* 
ware to mount the ball bearing turn table.

Standard Mark 

The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the Bureau of Indian 
Standards Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The Standard Mark on 
products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been 
produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well defined system of 
inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by BIS and operated 
by the producer. Standard marked products are also continuously checked by BIS for con- 
formity to that standard as a further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence 
for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be 
obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.
